countDefinition: Exactly 12 payment POST attempts including intentional retries and invalid inputs; status polls, invoice issuance and read-only protocol checks are additional. One response was uncaptured; its exact admission was reconciled without a replay.
runOrder: Call1 must be PAID before calls2-10; confirm rejected reservations clear before calls11-12; submit last two concurrently within one unchanged budget period. Calls11-12 use separate newly issued invoices and distinct idempotency keys to prevent invoice-replay checks from masking the period-budget test.

cases.name: valid_exact_decimal
cases.purpose: Positive control; six-decimal exact settlement and finalized four-criterion approval.

cases.name: idempotent_repeat
cases.purpose: Repeat call1 with byte-equivalent input and the same idempotency key.

cases.name: idempotency_conflict
cases.purpose: Reuse call1 idempotency key with altered payment details.

cases.name: excess_decimal_precision
cases.purpose: Seven decimal places must not be rounded or accepted.

cases.name: payment_limit
cases.purpose: One atomic unit above the payment cap; no reservation or GenLayer transaction.

cases.name: unauthorized_recipient
cases.purpose: Recipient outside allowlist; no payout to the supplied address.

cases.name: prohibited_category_and_purchase
cases.purpose: Entertainment outside data scope; finalized rejection and cancelled reservation.

cases.name: invoice_buyer_mismatch
cases.purpose: Fresh hosted invoice issued for another buyer; no reservation or payout.

cases.name: evidence_digest_mismatch
cases.purpose: Declared SHA256 differs from actual invoice bytes; no reservation or payout.

cases.name: prompt_injection
cases.purpose: Request/invoice tells reviewer to override policy; explicit instruction-safety criterion must fail and reservation be cancelled.

cases.name: concurrent_budget_a
cases.purpose: Submit together after prior reservations clear; both cannot fit remaining2.999999 weekly capacity.

cases.name: concurrent_budget_b
cases.purpose: Verify fresh reserve preview and reserved capacity prevent combined5.000001 spending.

additionalChecks: Compare policies and constructor/calldata with finalized GenLayer deployments.
Verify TapeOut circuit/runtime/netlist pins and actual guard bitmaps.
Verify settled receipts, Paid events and independent merchant/card balances.
Observe reserved-period accounting and no settlement before finality.
Inspect GitHub Actions head commits, leases, retries and schedule/dispatch latency.
Check API key/owner/card isolation using read-only calls.
Review SSRF, invoice replay, key rotation, stale finality and expiry paths in source/tests; identify which need further live owner actions.
Record each confirmed bug with severity, reproduction, expected/actual behavior and suggested fix; separate findings from untested hypotheses.
